extraction_notes: Only thermocatalytic CO2 methanation data measured in this paper are included. CO methanation stability data in Figure 5c were excluded as CO methanation without CO2. Reactor-modeling and DFT/microkinetic simulated performances were excluded. Figure 5 values are approximate readings from the plotted markers. Table 3 TOF values were merged into the corresponding 250 °C Figure 5 records; the 10^-2 multiplier in the column header was applied. Catalyst metal loadings are ICP values from Table 1.
